findings.anchor: renderChoice - the secret is not on screen
findings.problem: The secret is shown once, on the scene screen, then the player makes three decisions across three screens that are all judged against it. The thing being staged is held in working memory while the staging happens. For the founder profile that is the worst possible place to put the load, and it is the one piece of text the whole game hangs on.
findings.fix: Carry a one-line strip at the top of each choice screen - the fact only, the same bold underline - so the secret is present at the moment it is being served.
findings.evidence: secret rendered only in renderSecret; renderChoice has no reference to scene().secret

findings.anchor: the house, v14 - no visible count, key or note
findings.problem: The house scores the player - SHOW +8 seats, TELL -3 - and by founder ruling shows no count, no key and no explanation. A scored activity whose criteria are never shown. The house is beautiful and it is also the gradebook. A player who reads the drawing as atmosphere will not learn that announcing the secret cost them seats, which is precisely the lesson.
findings.fix: Contested - see the dissent in the convening. Minimum that preserves the ruling: when seats leave, let them leave visibly, so cause and effect are witnessed without a word being written.
findings.framework: constructive alignment - criteria must be knowable
findings.evidence: houseBlock renders svg only; count survives in aria-label alone

findings.anchor: header comment line 'Craft target: ... EN195 Workshop 3, Lens 3'
findings.problem: The competency this build is aimed at exists in an HTML comment. No iSLO is named anywhere, the build has no convening file until today, and nothing connects it to the assessment instruments the studio already owns. For a build this close to the ISLO suite that is a missed join, not just a missing line.
findings.fix: Name the iSLO in the convening file and in the trunk's suite map, and say in one line which instrument would score the same competency.
findings.evidence: grep iSLO on the surface: no match; convening/ROW-K-CONVENING.md did not exist before this run

findings.anchor: scene screen, curtain + ink plate before first action
findings.problem: About 4.5 seconds of animation runs before the player can act on a scene - the curtain to 3.1s, the plate inking behind it. Lovely, and on a replay it is effort spent on decoration rather than the idea.
findings.fix: Folded into the MOTION-GRATUITOUS fix - full performance once per scene per session, fast haul thereafter.
